entries.name: ua-parser-js
entries.summary: Compromised ua-parser-js releases executed malicious install scripts.
entries.recommendation: Upgrade to a safe ua-parser-js release and rotate credentials that may have been exposed.

entries.name: @ctrl/tinycolor
entries.summary: Known malicious package release associated with npm supply-chain compromise indicators.
entries.recommendation: Remove this version, reinstall from a trusted lockfile, and inspect postinstall activity.

entries.name: coa
entries.summary: Compromised coa releases attempted credential theft via install-time malware.
entries.recommendation: Upgrade to a safe version and audit machines that installed the affected releases.

entries.name: rc
entries.summary: Compromised rc releases contained malicious install behavior.
entries.recommendation: Pin to a known-good release and rebuild from a clean dependency cache.

entries.name: eslint-scope
entries.summary: Historical compromised npm release with malicious credential-harvesting behavior.
entries.recommendation: Upgrade immediately and review npm tokens used on the affected host.

entries.name: event-stream
entries.summary: Compromised event-stream dependency chain introduced targeted malware.
entries.recommendation: Remove the affected dependency tree and inspect built artifacts.

entries.name: flatmap-stream
entries.summary: Malicious package used in the event-stream compromise.
entries.recommendation: Remove this package and rebuild from a trusted lockfile.
